Subject: QBR + roadmap demo — condensed option request

Hi Mateo / Marissa,

We’re getting close to our renewal and would like to do a condensed QBR + roadmap demo focused on the expansion use cases we discussed (prefix/KV caching, routing policies). Our execs have very limited calendar space — would you be open to a "lite" sprint across two short sessions instead of a full half-day?

High level ask: can we run two 45-minute sessions (tech deep-dive + exec highlight) over two adjacent days, with a single recording and a one-page follow-up? If yes, please propose 3 slot options and a brief agenda.

Attaching our availability file (customer-availability.ics). Oliver (CC) will help coordinate.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Director, Platform Engineering
Brightside Health

Hi Samantha — thanks for the note and the availability. We can definitely do a compact "lite QBR" flow. Suggested approach below so you can share with execs and ops:

Proposed flow (2 sessions):
- Day 1 (45m): Technical deep-dive (batching/caching/quantization recommendations, perf numbers) — 30m presentation + 15m QA
- Day 2 (45m): Exec summary and decision items (cost/rollback/rollout plan) — 25m exec walkthrough + 20m alignment

Slot options (all PT):
A) Tue May 14 — 10:00–10:45 / Wed May 15 — 10:00–10:45
B) Wed May 15 — 14:00–14:45 / Thu May 16 — 14:00–14:45 (preferred for our ENG leads)
C) Thu May 16 — 08:30–09:15 / Fri May 17 — 08:30–09:15

I’m attaching a short agenda (QBR-lite-agenda-v1.pdf) and an .ics for the preferred option B. If none of these work, tell us your single-day windows and we’ll compress into a single 60-minute runbook.

Do you have any specific exec names and decision owners to invite (billing, security, infra)? We’ll include a one-page follow-up with clear next steps and the SOW/DocuSign link if you want pre-review.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: QBR-lite-agenda-v1.pdf, preferred-slots.ics
